actionable_recommendations.finding: Overnight base load (01:00-04:00) averages 44.0 kWh/h, representing 71.4% of peak daytime consumption even when buildings are largely unoccupied.
actionable_recommendations.action: Audit 24/7 continuous plug loads, emergency lighting overrides, and ventilation damper positions. Implement automated smart scheduling to de-energize non-critical circuits outside operating hours.
actionable_recommendations.benefit: Curtails unnecessary non-working hour electricity waste without disrupting occupant comfort.

actionable_recommendations.finding: Ambient temperatures above 30°C increase hourly building energy by 10.9% compared to mild baseline days (16-22°C), driving heavy midday chiller loads.
actionable_recommendations.action: Utilize day-ahead temperature forecasts from this model to initiate passive pre-cooling of building thermal mass during early morning hours (05:00-07:30) before external solar gain peaks.
actionable_recommendations.benefit: Flattens afternoon cooling peaks and mitigates high electrical demand spikes on campus substations.

actionable_recommendations.finding: Weekend energy consumption drops by 15.9% on average, but variance across facilities shows some buildings maintain near-weekday baselines.
actionable_recommendations.action: Harmonize building management system (BMS) calendar triggers with university semester and exam schedules to enforce aggressive temperature deadband expansion (e.g. 19°C-26°C) when spaces are vacant.
actionable_recommendations.benefit: Reduces HVAC runtime across empty lecture halls and administrative offices during breaks.

actionable_recommendations.finding: Top consuming categories (Libraries and Mixed-Use Complexes) consume 2.5x to 4.4x the campus average, primarily driven by continuous mechanical ventilation requirements.
actionable_recommendations.action: Prioritize demand-controlled ventilation (DCV) retrofits using indoor CO2 sensors and variable frequency drives (VFDs) on air-handling units in high-footprint buildings.
actionable_recommendations.benefit: Enables air exchange rates to dynamically match actual occupant density rather than design maximums.
